user.title: Connect inexogy
user.description: Log in with your inexogy portal account. Optionally enter the meter number (e.g. 1ABC0012345678) to add a specific meter; leave it empty to use your account's default meter.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate inexogy
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {email} was rejected. Please enter the current password.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure inexogy
reconfigure.description: Change the login of this entry. The measurement series stays the same; to add another meter, add a new entry.

data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the current password.
